title: Python: versioned plans and full permitted sets
description:
Implement CCP2-003/005/006/023 plan representation in python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py and reconcile its boundary with python/src/lichen/link/op_class.py. Retain ordered integer-Hz entries, stable global indices, distinct plan/version and operating-class identifiers, and canonical variable-length permitted masks. Unknown or unqualified plans must not establish a usable control frequency. A representable candidate plan is not permission to enable it.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse b7z9.23's existing intersection mechanics, but do not carry its legacy u32 truncation or least-significant-bit convention into CCP2. The old issue is a reference, not a prerequisite edge. Extend current modules and tests without a new registry framework or dependency. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil identity, radio ownership, baseline SCHC/security and best-effort custody; key portability remains deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Consume frozen vectors.03 through production lookup and mask APIs. Exercise counts 0, 1, 8, 32, 64, 128, 255 and 256; boundary indices; wrong mask lengths; nonzero padding; empty and CH0-only sets; and sparse indices {0,64,127}. Assert the independent mask bytes 80000000000000008000000000000001 and exact physical frequencies. Run python/tests/test_channel_plan.py, python/tests/test_channel_plan_boundaries.py and python/tests/test_ccp4_regional_channel_plans.py, preserving explicitly legacy expectations. Run scoped pytest, ruff and configured channel_plan typing from python/pyproject.toml.
